cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Act as If It’s True
cards.instruction: Ask for one concrete choice that would only make sense if the impossible premise were true.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. The ceiling's hungry. Turn the breakfast tray upside down so it can eat. Please.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. Keep half for us. Just turn its bowl over.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll use the tray to catch anything it drops.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good. Hold it under the light fitting; that's where it dribbled yesterday.

mechanism: A directs breakfast for a hungry ceiling, reduces its portion to preserve B food and uses B catching plan to enact the impossible appetite.
confusable: Unlike merely pretending to believe, A requests physical food inversion and tray placement that only make sense under the ceiling premise.
comparison: Protecting scarce breakfast while feeding a ceiling differs from seating two temporal versions of a guest.
seedUse: D155-a porridge, half portion, catch tray and light fitting; S02-a adjusts to B scarcity concern without abandoning the request.
